tei:div.tei:p: dmar gsur la brten nas rang gzhan gyi 'chi ba bslu ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ dmar gsur 'dod yon rgya mtsho 'di// dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams la// zas kyi nyer len mi mnga' yang*// mchod pa'i yul du dmigs nas 'bul// bdag cag bsod nams tshogs rdzogs nas// myur du ye shes mthong bar shog /mgon po yon tan mgron rnams la// zag med bdud rtsir dmigs nas 'bul// byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i// 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs las srungs// rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams kyis// rang rang 'dod pa'i longs spyod du// mthong nas zad med gter la spyod// dga' mgu tshims shing yi rangs nas// so so'i sdug bsngal bral bar shog /bgegs rigs lan chags mgron rnams la// pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med par bsngo// so so'i yid la gang 'dod pa'i// zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod du// gyur nas sha 'khon bu lon byang*// gnod sems 'khon 'dzin dag par shog /khyad par gzhan gyi lus srog la// rnam par sdang ba'i gnod sbyin dang*// sha za srin po 'byung po'i gdon// tshe brku mdangs 'phrog srog len cing*// sha dang khrag la gdung ba rnams// dmar gsur 'dod yon kun khyab 'dis// ngoms shing tshims la mthun gyur cing*// khro zhing gtum pa'i sems bor nas// byang chub sems dang ldan par shog /rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag mthus// byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin las// rang gi yul khams srung ba bzhin// mthar thug rang gzhan don yod cing*// gnas skabs 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las// 'gro ba mang po'i srog thar shog /gang zhig 'di ru lhags pa yi// sa'am 'on te bar snang gnas// 'byung po gdug pa'i sems ldan kyang*// rgyud la byang chub sems skyes nas// gzhan la 'tshe ba'i blo spangs te// thar pa'i sa bon thebs par shog

/chos sbyin dang dge ba bsngo/ spyir dus la nges pa med cing khyad par mun srod la gnod sbyin rnams gzhan gyi srog la 'tshe ba'i slad du rgyu ba yin pas/ de tshe dmar gsur sbyar zhing rang gi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa thun mong du gyur pa 'di byas na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin no/ zhes pa'ang klong gsal dang chos ldan pas bskul ngor rig pa 'dzin pa mkhyen brtse'i lhas so//
